description.en: The Catppuccin Mocha palette: soft pastel colors on a warm dark base, rounded and cozy, with a mauve accent by default. CSS only, so organization admins can install it.
The button, links and focused fields. Mocha's accents include mauve #cba6f7, pink #f5c2e7, peach #fab387, green #a6e3a1, sky #89dceb and lavender #b4befe.
